decision.explanation: All five candidates are directly supported by the original sources. D1S2 and multiple supporting passages confirm 'desservant' as a valid ecclesiastical position. D1S8 and D2S10 independently confirm 'member of the Council of State' and 'Prefect of the Seine-et-Oise department'. D2S5 confirms 'deputy to the National Convention', and D2S2 confirms 'member of the Chamber of Peers'. These are distinct roles held by Sainte-Hermine at different times and are not contradictory. All are preserved as valid, non-overlapping positions.
